explanations.text:
[name_to_map](name_to_map)(name, project_root):
 a helper function which takes a name from the command and returns a path:
   if path is a folder, return human/human.json and sort type folder.
   if a file's abstraction like app.py then returns human/explanation_src__app.py.json and sort type file.
   if project then it's the abstraction of the whole project so human/project.json and sort type project.
   if a new abstraction. similar to project.json which abstracts to multiple files. then it's not a single file's abstraction and it's human/human_<name>.json, and sort type human file.
 if a file at the top of the folder answers to project or human file bare name. human init gives a warning.

[find_root](find_root)(path)                  
 given a path return the folder at or above path that holds human/human.json


[rel_name](rel_name)(code_path, project_root)
 the path of a file from the root, like src/app.py


[map_path_of](map_path_of)(code_path, project_root)
 the map file of a code file: human/explanation_<path>.json, the slashes written as __
 if map is folder, return human/human.json
